method: Equal 60000 starting troops, fair economy/combat rules, two 5000-tile halves of Plains, all structures/weapons/alliances disabled, Hard reaction difficulty, 6000-tick cap; 30 seeds x swapped starts, tribe controllers. Draws are unfinished at the cap. Losses are troop conservation (combat + retreat), not a classification of unnecessary loss. No-op means an attack execution becomes inactive on its first tick; successful immediate cancellation can also meet that definition.
